text: If the product availability check does not confirm availability, the system shall not create the shopping cart for that product.
The system shall update the inventory quantity to reflect a product addition when product availability is confirmed and the product is added to the shopping cart.
The system shall show the customer confirmation message after the product availability check confirms the product can be added and the shopping cart has been created.
The system shall load and present personalized dashboard content when an authenticated customer is redirected to their personalized dashboard after login.
The system shall enforce authorization for the product information update operation so that only authorized Administrators can perform it.
The system shall perform a product availability check before adding an item to the shopping cart.
The system shall record the confirmation event in Purchase History with sufficient status and timestamp information to distinguish generation from successful delivery.
The system shall record only successful plugin development or installation events in Purchase History data.
The system shall define how existing product associations are detached or reassigned before completing the removal of a category.
The system shall define and enforce a category deletion policy that specifies whether a deleted category is physically removed or marked inactive and how associated product records are affected.
